Review title: Lux ANC Review - Great Color and Comfortable
Review Text:
I received the Lux ANC headphones through the Amazon Vine program.  They paired quickly to my Motorola G 5G (2023) phone with Google Fast pair and also with my Chromebook.   

I love the Cloud white/grey color.  The ear cups have a unique egg shape.  They extend and fit my 23" head with room to spare.  The headband and pads are very comfortable.  

The control buttons are very large and easy to operate by touch.  I like the voice prompts for power, connect, ANC, and EQ modes.  

I tested the sound with three songs: Sleep Token - "The Summoning", Lauren Daigle - "Kaleidescope Jesus", and Chris Botti - "My Funny Valentine".  I felt the sound in JLab Signature mode was very well balanced but a little quiet.  I was not as impressed with the Balanced and Bass modes.  Once I created my custom EQ in the app I left it on that setting because it amplified everything to my liking.  

The app is nicely designed and has useful settings for ANC, EQ, button mapping, and firmware upgrades.  

My only deduction is for lack of a storage bag/case.

JLAB never disappoints. This is my third pair of over ear headphones, and these are the most solid of the ones I’ve had. The sound quality is amazing. The noise cancellation is unbelievably shocking and the comfortability of the headset is so pleasing Plus the app is very user-friendly. I don’t even look at the more expensive brands.
I bought them a week ago, i had to tweak the EQ a bit to get them to my liking. But overall good headphones.

[This review was collected as part of a promotion.] These headphones EAT!!! I love the battery life which is crazy cause the more expensive ones have LESS hours! I workout with them as well and they are solid on my head the entire time. It’s a bonus that I can change the setting of the sound and that’s worth it. I wear glasses too and I feel no pain or pushing whatsoever and I can’t even feel it when I’m wearing earrings. Definitely worth the money!

Got them little less than a month, use them mon-fri... the sound is great, they stay in place with all my workouts, I'm getting use to the ear pads, i have some piercings and sometimes I guess i dont place them the right way on top of my ear and is uncomfortable, i have to reposition and find the that sweet spot.

I have purchased many headphones over the years. And has been disappointed many times because the sound quality of most of my choices were poor. But this headphone set is surely what I've been looking for. Great sound quality!!! No joke whatsoever! These bad boys come equipped with Noice cancellation, Dolby Sound, Movie and music mode. Movie mode allows for a better  audio sync when watching movies will listening through your headphones. I have even found that it helps while making music in FL Studio. Great all around for what I use then for. No complaints from me. Also, great battery life as well. I recommend these to anyone who wants great quality at a great price.
